S.name: Months per year in which the average gross % per trade is above 1%

GM.name: Months per year whose trades add up to 5% or more (the month's total gross %)

basis.ranking: overall progress = average of four fractions: gross % per trade / 3%, win rate / 75%, share of months whose average trade is above 1%, share of months whose total is 5% or more (each capped at 1); methods with fewer than 15 blind trades are not ranked

same_time_rule.rule: trades opened at exactly the same time count as one trade; different times count separately

risk_rule.note: levels count, and a method is ranked, only if its worst trade is within the limit
